ABOUT US

The Information Technology Administration oversees every technical service and system within the organization. We develop, update and maintain them to keep operations efficient and uninterrupted. We also protect data and information, monitor systems and networks, regulate the use of technology resources, and provide technical support to departments and units, helping to raise the quality of work, simplify administrative procedures, and sustain these gains over the long term in line with approved standards and controls.
